sampling.method: seeded multinomial sampling of the ideal Qiskit statevector distribution

qubo.evaluation_convention: constant + x.T @ matrix_upper_triangle @ x; each i<j pair occurs once

circuit_metadata.phase_convention: exp(-i*gamma*(H-offset*I)/energy_scale); offset omitted as a global phase

optimizer_message: Return from COBYLA because the objective function has been evaluated MAXFUN times.
bit_order: Rightmost bit selects candidate 0; 1 means include the whole peptide.

scoring_method.charge: ProteinAnalysis.charge_at_pH; Bjellqvist pKa model; elementary-charge units
scoring_method.mass: ProteinAnalysis.molecular_weight; average isotopic mass, Da; linear free-termini peptide
scoring_method.charge_score: 1 / (1 + abs(charge - target_charge) / 2); fixed charge tolerance 2 e
scoring_method.hydropathy_score: 1 / (1 + abs(GRAVY - target_hydropathy)); fixed tolerance 1 GRAVY unit
scoring_method.candidate_score: Weighted mean of charge_score and hydropathy_score; normalized to [0,1]
scoring_method.pair_penalty: Jaccard overlap of unique adjacent residue pairs; sequence-redundancy proxy in [0,1]

limitations: Research selection of whole peptide references, not a physical blend simulation or dosing recommendation.
Calculated free-termini sequence descriptors ignore 3D structure, solvent, chemical modifications, and interactions.
Records with documented modifications are excluded; absent modification annotations do not verify a chemical form.
Charge estimates and hydropathy are model-dependent; no calibrated uncertainty or experimental validation is supplied.
Targets apply to individual candidate descriptors; mixture charge, solubility, compatibility, and efficacy are not predicted.
Sequence redundancy is a diversity preference, not a measured peptide-peptide interaction or synergy.
Classical filtering creates the small pool; QAOA runs only on that pool, not the entire database.
The exact reference is optimal only within the supplied pool and objective; no quantum speedup is claimed.
QAOA results use ideal statevector simulation and simulated measurements, not quantum hardware.
